config.confee.general.injectConfigButton: Adds a Config button to mods that have none, to edit their config files (universal editor).
Mods without a config screen get a Config button that edits their files. Needs a restart.
config.confee.general.backupExternalFile: Keeps a copy of a mod's file before Confee changes it for the first time, in config/confee/backups. Needed to restore original values.
A copy of each mod file is kept before its first change, to restore the original values.
config.confee.external.fileMappings.tool: Files Confee could not link to their mod. One entry per file: modid=path (path relative to config/).
config.confee.external.fileMappings.desc: For files Confee could not link to their mod: one modid=path per entry (path relative to config/).
config.confee.external.ignoredMods.toolt: Mod IDs that never get a Config button from Confee.
config.confee.external.ignoredMods.descr: These mods get no Config button from Confee and are never edited by it. Needs a restart.
config.confee.external.forceConfeeEditor: Mod IDs whose own config screen is replaced by the Confee editor. Only mods whose config files Confee finds; ignored mods are never replaced. Applies on the next click on Config.
Open the Confee editor instead of these mods' own config screen. Applies on the next click on Config.
